clinicsPage.intro: Onboarding a new clinic creates a real Keycloak Organization for its staff, then this platform's own record of it. Fill in the admin email/name below to also create an initial clinic_admin login for it - leave both blank to onboard the clinic with nobody able to log in yet, same as before.
clinicsPage.errorFieldsRequired: Name, org alias, and domain are all required.
clinicsPage.errorOnboard: Could not onboard this clinic - the org alias may already be taken.
clinicsPage.tempPasswordNote: Temporary password (shown once, not recoverable afterward - hand it to them out of band):

brandingPage.intro: Your logo, colours and patient-facing name. Applied to the staff workspace and, once used there, patient-facing pages. Leave a field blank to use the platform default.
brandingPage.displayNameHint: Shown instead of the clinic's legal name

brandingPage.errorColorHex: {{label}} must be a hex value like #1D4ED8.
brandingPage.errorLogoUrl: Logo URL must start with http:// or https://.

feePoliciesPage.intro: Tiers are matched by hours-before-appointment, highest cutoff first. A provider-specific set of tiers replaces the clinic-wide default entirely for that provider - the two are never merged. No tiers configured at all means a 0% fee.
feePoliciesPage.emptyDescription: Every cancellation/no-show fee is 0% until you add one above.
feePoliciesPage.errorCreate: Could not create this tier - one with the same cutoff may already exist.

labRatesPage.intro: A lab test can only be ordered once a rate exists for its code - there's no separate fixed test catalog.
labRatesPage.errorFields: A test code and a non-negative base charge are required.

accountantPage.accountsDescription: The chart of accounts backing the ledger - a starter set (Cash, Service Revenue, Refunds & Allowances, Salary Expense) is seeded automatically the first time this list loads.

accountantPage.emptyPayrollDescription: Run payroll above for the first time.
